Alex —

Great to be partnering with Horizon on this pilot. Quick check on the brand/reference items in the order form before we send final:

- Are you looking for a standard logo + "Customer of" attribution, or would you like us to include a more explicit "endorsement" statement in the marketing copy? Those mean different legal scopes.
- For logo use, do you require use of the full color/clearspace variants in the attached brand guidelines (Horizon_Logo_Guidelines.pdf)?
- Preferred approval SLA for any quote/attribution: 3 business days? We typically ask for 5 for press releases.
- Any embargo window for joint announcements (if any)?

I'm attaching an iteration of the order form with inline redlines that frame the asks we've heard from your side: orderform-redline-v3.docx. For efficiency, if Horizon Legal wants to send a short clause they prefer, we can slot it into the MSA/order form and run it past our counsel.

Proposed next steps:
1) If this is just logo+attribution, Kimberly can provide a compact clause that works for both sides.
2) If Horizon wants an endorsement, Legal will need to review and we should expect slightly broader review cycles.
3) Confirm logo assets and any embargo/announcement window so marketing can prepare assets.

Thanks — keen to close this out this week if possible.

Ben Carter

Alex / Horizon Legal — thanks for the quick clarification that you do not want an explicit endorsement. Attached is a concise set of redline suggestions that we recommend inserting in the Order Form and MSA to cover logo use, attribution, and quote approvals: orderform-redline-v3.docx (included) and redline-summary-table.csv (summary).

High-level recommendations (suggest these exact snippets to reduce back-and-forth):

1) Logo & attribution (Order Form, new clause):
"Customer may grant Vendor a non-exclusive, non-transferable, revocable license to use Customer's name and logo solely to identify Customer as a customer of Vendor in marketing materials, case studies, and on Vendor's website. Any use of Customer's name, logo, or a direct quote shall be subject to Customer's prior written approval, which Customer shall not unreasonably withhold and shall provide within five (5) business days of submission. No language shall imply endorsement of Vendor's products or services by Customer."

2) Confidentiality carveout for attribution (MSA, confidentiality section):
"Notwithstanding the Confidentiality obligations, Vendor may include Customer's name and the fact of a commercial relationship in aggregated lists and public-facing customer pages, provided that Vendor obtains prior written consent for use of Customer logos or substantive quotes. Any customer quote used in public materials shall be provided to Customer for approval and may not be used prior to Customer's written sign-off."

3) Embargo and announcement timing:
"Both parties agree to coordinate public announcements and will use commercially reasonable efforts to respect an embargo period of thirty (30) days from the date either party notifies the other party of its intent to make a public announcement. Either party may propose a shorter window by mutual written agreement."

4) Asset specs & delivery: keep a reference to the Horizon_Logo_Guidelines.pdf with a clause that Vendor shall only use the variants and clearspace specified and shall not modify the logo beyond cropping and sizing with prior approval.

Why these suggestions: they keep the scope narrow (logo + attribution), avoid endorsement language, give Horizon control over quotes, and set a clear SLA for approvals so marketing can plan. If Horizon Legal prefers a 3-day SLA, we can accommodate but ask that press releases retain a 5-business-day review cycle.

If Horizon Legal sends back a short clause, we can incorporate quickly. Attaching the two files noted above for redline insertion.

Kimberly Park
